What is C++.title: What is C++
What is C++.content: C++ is a general-purpose programming language created by Bjarne Stroustrup as an extension of the C programming language. It has imperative, object-oriented and generic programming features. C++ is known for its performance and is widely used in developing systems software, games, real-time systems, and large-scale applications.

Why Learn C++.title: Why Learn C++
Why Learn C++.content: Learning C++ is valuable because it's a foundational language that teaches fundamental programming concepts such as memory management, object-oriented programming, and high-performance computing. It is used in developing operating systems, browsers, games, and complex applications requiring speed and efficiency.
